Maya (sales-eng): Quick sync — Edgelytics wants hardened infra for an enterprise deal. Mixed traffic: conversational chat (stateful, kv-cache heavy) + high-rate embeddings for similarity search. They asked what to reserve vs autoscale.
Julian (solutions): Do we have their traffic profile? peak rps, token distributions?
Maya (sales-eng): From their questionnaire: typical steady chat ~120 rps, peaks 600 rps during events (15–30m), avg prompt+response ~180 tokens, embeddings steady 800 qps with occasional spikes to 2k qps. KV cache hit target 60%.
Priya (infra): Sounds like a mixed-latency/throughput workload. Suggest reserved pool for chat control plane and low-latency SLOs + autoscale-able pool for embeddings. Provisional sizing: reserve 4 GPUs for chat (predictable latency) and allow autoscale up to +6 GPUs for bursts/embeds.
Omar (billing): What's the cost delta vs reserving 8 GPUs? They want a clear pricing delta.
Priya (infra): Rough math (ballpark): 4 reserved GPUs @ enterprise rate = X/mo, autoscale adds usage pricing only during bursts. If they reserve 8, baseline cost doubles but removes autoscale unpredictability. We should give them both scenarios with expected monthly token/embedding units.
Julian (solutions): Also note cold-start of kv-cache -> first 3–5 minutes of a sustained burst will have higher p95. We can recommend a short pre-warm window around scheduled events and a small preheat credit.
Maya (sales-eng): Customer asked about fallback behavior if autoscale can't get more GPUs (AZ contention). We need a graceful degradation plan.
Priya (infra): We can configure routing policy: prefer reserved pool (SLO), fallback to elastic pool (higher latency), final fallback to a cheaper quantized model. Recommend these rules in order. Also add token-based throttling for embeddings during critical chat windows.
Julian (solutions): For the POC, propose this test plan:
- 72-hour mixed-load test with scheduled event windows (simulate 600 rps chat + 2k qps embed bursts)
- Measure p50/p95/p99 for chat and embedding throughput, KV cache warmup time, and autoscale latency
- Run one controlled AZ failure to validate fallback routing

Maya (sales-eng): Can you draft the autoscale config snippet we should send them? Keep it conservative.
Priya (infra): Sure — send this as a suggestion (they can tune):
```json
{
  "reserved_pool": {"gpus": 4, "min_instances": 4},
  "elastic_pool": {"min_instances": 0, "max_instances": 6},
  "scale_policy": {
    "scale_up_threshold_rps": 450,
    "scale_up_cooldown_s": 60,
    "scale_down_threshold_rps": 200,
    "scale_down_cooldown_s": 300
  },
  "prewarm_windows": [{"cron": "0 18 * * *", "duration_mins": 20}]
}
```
Julian (solutions): Nice. Also call out model variants for fallback and quantization levels so quality teams can evaluate regressions.
Omar (billing): For the quote: I'll prepare two line items — "Reserved 4 GPU baseline + autoscale credits" and "Reserved 8 GPU flat". Need an estimate of monthly burst hours (Maya, can you confirm expected # of event hours/month?).
Maya (sales-eng): They said ~6 events/month, 30–45m each. I'll ask for a staging calendar to size prewarm and burst runway.
Priya (infra): Operational notes to include in the handoff doc:
- KV cache TTLs and prefix caching to hit 60% faster
- Canary rollout plan for model updates (10% -> 50% -> 100%)
- Alerting: p95 chat latency > 400ms, autoscale failures, and embedding queue growth

Maya (sales-eng): Security questionnaire flag: they want KMS integration and audit logs for inference requests. Ops-bot: do we have a template?
ops-bot: Link to KMS + audit docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/kms-audit (shared).
Julian (solutions): Next steps: I'll draft the POC runbook (traffic scripts + success criteria) and Priya will outline the infra playbook (reserved vs autoscale + fallback). Omar will attach pricing options. Maya to collect event schedule and security Q answers.
Maya (sales-eng): Perfect — setting a 30-min handoff with Edgelytics for tomorrow 09:30 PT. Will share convo notes and the draft runbook after the meeting. :thumbsup:
Priya (infra): I'll pre-populate metrics dashboard templates (latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization).
Omar (billing): Sending initial quote by EOD.
Maya (sales-eng): Thanks all. If we can get the staging calendar today, we can lock the POC config and the pricing delta.
Julian (solutions): Marking action items: runbook (Julian), infra playbook (Priya), quote (Omar), schedule (Maya).
Maya (sales-eng): End of thread — will paste final runbook here when ready.
